title: LIVE WAVE HEIGHT/PERIOD/DIRECTION
source_name: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — HTSGW height + PERPW peak period + WVDIR direction, surface analysis (single cycle)
variable: HTSGW significant height (base color, ft) + PERPW peak period (white labels, s) + WVDIR travel arrows (FROM+180), all surface analysis step 0 from the SAME cycle file
source_units: m (height source), s (period source), degrees (direction source)
display_units: ft base + seconds labels + travel arrows
coverage: Lake water only: Great Lakes cut by the shared NOAA shoreline mask, land fully transparent.
arrows: Arrows show the toward-travel vector (WVDIR filed FROM direction + 180 deg, standard oceanographic handling), white shaft with dark outline — pixel-identical style to the wave_direction layer.
labels: White period labels with dark halo in the same arrow style, placed just above a decimated subset of arrows (every Nth) plus extras where period changes sharply even with no arrow nearby. Format is seconds with one decimal, e.g. 4.2s.
note: Turn on/off independently of all other layers. Does not modify wave_height or wave_direction.
